Almost everybody who works in artificial intelligence should know something about the Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP). CSPs appear in many areas, instance, vision, resource allocationin schedulign and temporal reasoning. This CSP is worth studying in isolation because it is a general problem that has unique features which can be exploited to arrive at solutions. The main objective of the book is to identify these properties and explain techniques for tackling CSPs.

Several recommendations are also suggested for the future work at the end of this thesis.
Parametic study on ductility of RC beams strengthened with external reinforcement /

Recently, repair and rehabilitation of degrading and aging concrete structure have become more challenging. Bonding of steel plates or other advanced composite materials to the tension face of the beam is one of the methods for strengthening these deteriorated concrete structures. This may increase the strength and stiffness of the concrete structure, nevertheless the corresponding ductility will be effected at the same time. It is absolutely important for this parametric study to present how the ductility of reinforced concrete beam is being affected by increasing the strength of the beam using externally bonded steel plates. An analytical model was developed to obtain the ductility of the unstrengthened and strengthened beams, and hence the ductility ratio.
A comparative study of aedes (Stegomyia) aegypti (Linnaeus) and aedes (Stegomyia) albopictus (Skuse) (Diptera Culicidae) in their breeding ecology and feeding patterns in three areas in Sarawak /
Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences.

A survey was carried out to determine the distribution of two dengue vectors, Ae.aegypti and Ae. albopictus in Kota Samarahan (rural coastal area), Sibu (urban town area) and Miri (suburban squatters area), Sarawak, Malaysia from January 1998 to December 2000. All positive water-holding containers in and around the house were checked for Ae. aegypti and Ae. albopictus immature. Adult females engored with bllod were collected in Sibu and Miri, for both species. The blood meals were identified by using ELISA method to detect different types of hosts and the probability of multiple feeding in one gonotrophic cycle. Parity rates and main-biting rates of Ae. aegypti and Ae. albopictus were calculated in order to estimate vectorial capacity in this study.

The nutrients such as phosphate and nitrate are believe to be the key for eutrophication. Eutrophication will lead to various problems such as toxic alga bloom loss of marine food supply and habitat. This study had been focused on the factors such as initial nutrients loading, pH, dissolved oxygen level and to suspended solid that affect the sorption and release of nutrients (phosphate and nitrate) from sediments to the water column, and on developing an empirical model to predict the potential eutrophication of Sg. Sarawak. This research has identified that under anoxic (low DO) and acidic (low pH) conditions, phosphorus release from sediments was enhanced.
